title: Ten extra or ten percent extra
hook: A fixed spare count and a percentage spare count diverge as a job grows.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Distinguish a proportional allowance from a fixed spare count.

misconception: Ten percent extra always means ten extra pieces.
objective: Distinguish a proportional allowance from a fixed spare count.

claims.text: Compare an order with 10% extra, rounded up, against an order with ten extra tiles. Scaled model; quantity-only model; no installation advice.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Required=40tiles, A=44tiles and B=50tiles. The geometry pictures follow the declared dimension relationships; other stage pictures are scaled to the larger displayed comparison and icons are not literal item counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["ceil",["*","x",1.1]]; B=["+","x",10]; x denotes Required. At x=40, A=44, B=50; recall at x=55: B=65. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals.

claims.text: A fixed extra count stays ten. A percentage extra grows with the requirement. At forty, 10% is four; at one hundred, 10% is ten. The formulas match only at that crossover.

recall.question: Compare an order with 10% extra, rounded up, against an order with ten extra tiles. Change only Required to 55tiles. What is B (Ten-extra) now?
recall.why: Use B's stated rule with Required=55tiles: it gives 65tiles. A fixed extra count stays ten. A percentage extra grows with the requirement. At forty, 10% is four; at one hundred, 10% is ten. The formulas match only at that crossover.

safety.assumptions: Compare an order with 10% extra, rounded up, against an order with ten extra tiles.
safety.excluded: No chemical mixtures, medical advice, wiring, safety-device bypass, actual tariffs, financial recommendations, temperature, food-storage or food-safety instructions. All energy powers, durations and tariffs are illustrative.
